title: Desire Me
description: A Frenchwoman's (Greer Garson) husband (Robert Mitchum), thought to be dead, returns from war and finds her in love with one (Richard Hart) of his comrades.

title: The Great Lie
description: A lost aviator's (George Brent) socialite wife (Bette Davis) makes a deal with a pianist (Mary Astor) having his baby.

title: Random Harvest
description: An amnesiac World War I British veteran (Ronald Colman) marries a chorus girl (Greer Garson), then forgets her.

title: I Know Where I'm Going!
description: A young Englishwoman (Wendy Hiller) aims to marry a tycoon but finds love with a naval officer (Roger Livesey) instead.

title: Dark Victory
description: An heiress (Bette Davis) with only months to live embarks on a social whirl, then marries her doctor (George Brent).

title: They Learned About Women
description: Lured by the glamour of the stage, two professional baseball players turn in their uniforms for careers in vaudeville.

title: Alibi Ike
description: An eccentric ballplayer known for his unorthodox pitching style finds major-league trouble with a girl and gangsters.

title: The Big Leaguer
description: Young players try out for the founder (Edward G. Robinson) of the New York Giants Florida training camp.

title: The Pride of the Yankees
description: Lou Gehrig (Gary Cooper) leads the New York baseball team for years and then, slowly dying, retires with a stadium farewell.

title: The Winning Team
description: Grover Cleveland Alexander (Ronald Reagan) becomes one of baseball's greatest pitchers, with his wife's (Doris Day) support.

title: Angels in the Outfield
description: The Pittsburgh Pirates' manager (Paul Douglas) sees hope after a newswoman (Janet Leigh) reports a girl saw angels on their side.

title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
description: Two dancing baseball players (Gene Kelly, Frank Sinatra) run into trouble with their team's new female owner (Esther Williams) and a gambler who doesn't want them to win the pennant.

title: The Jackie Robinson Story
description: After a successful baseball career in college and as a coach in the military, Jackie Robinson attracts the attention of Major League Baseball's Branch Rickey.

title: Sergeant Rutledge
description: A cavalry officer (Jeffrey Hunter) defends a sergeant (Woody Strode) accused of rape and a double murder.

title: The Harlem Globetrotters
description: An athlete drops out of college to join Abe Saperstein's basketball team.

title: The Horse Soldiers
description: Set during the Civil War, Colonel John Marlowe leads a Union Calvary brigade on a mission behind Confederate lines to destroy enemy railroads and supplies. The colonel is confronted with numerous challenges before reaching Union held Baton Rouge.

title: The Fish That Saved Pittsburgh
description: An astrologer (Stockard Channing) helps a water boy (James Bond III) match players to his basketball team's star (Julius Erving), whose sign is Pisces.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: Law of the Tropics
description: A nightclub singer (Constance Bennett) marries a jilted rubber salesman (Jeffrey Lynn) in the Amazon.

title: After Office Hours
description: A managing editor (Clark Gable) sends a socialite reporter (Constance Bennett) to spy on her boyfriend, mixed up in murder.

title: What Price Hollywood?
description: A director (Lowell Sherman) on a drunken slide makes a Brown Derby waitress (Constance Bennett) a star.

title: Bed of Roses
description: Two wayward women (Constance Bennett, Pert Kelton) go down the Mississippi by steamboat, looking for men to fleece.

title: Wild Bill Hickok Rides
description: Wild Bill (Bruce Cabot) and a casino queen (Constance Bennett) thwart a river-basin land-grabber (Warren William) working for Chicago big shots.

title: The Unsuspected
description: The narrator (Claude Rains) of a murder-mystery radio show is a killer, but his niece (Joan Caulfield) would never know it.

title: Smart Woman
description: A special prosecutor (Brian Aherne) falls in love with the lawyer (Constance Bennett) he opposes in a racketeer's murder trial.

title: Topper
description: The ghosts of socialites George (Cary Grant) and Marion (Constance Bennett) decide to help their friend, banker Cosmo Topper (Roland Young).

title: Topper Takes a Trip
description: The ghosts of socialite Marion (Constance Bennett) and her dog, Skippy, help Cosmo Topper (Roland Young) with his wife (Billie Burke) on the Riviera.

title: The Snake Pit
description: A man (Mark Stevens) commits his wife (Olivia de Havilland) to a mental hospital, where her doctor (Leo Genn) tries the latest therapy.

title: Suddenly, Last Summer
description: A New Orleans matriarch (Katharine Hepburn) tries to bribe a brain surgeon (Montgomery Clift) to lobotomize her niece (Elizabeth Taylor) who witnessed a murder.

title: Torture Garden
description: Sideshow mystic Dr. Diablo (Burgess Meredith) shows an Edgar Allan Poe fan (Jack Palance) and other after-hours patrons their futures.

title: From Beyond the Grave
description: The sinister owner (Peter Cushing) of a London antiques shop leads customers into four tales of terror.

title: Kwaidan
description: Japanese ghost stories from tales by Lafcadio Hearn include a samurai (Rentarô Mikuni) who wakes up with a corpse (Michiyo Aratama).

title: Three Cases of Murder
description: A trilogy of strange tales features too-real art, a crime of passion and a man who seeks revenge through deadly dreams.

title: Painted Desert
description: Hugh buys the deed to the Banning mine, and sells it to Bob when he thinks it is worthless. When he learns the mine is full of tungsten, he sets out to get it back.

title: Powdersmoke Range
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Harry Carey, Hoot Gibson, Guinn Williams) fight a gambler and his henchmen for a ranch.

title: Yellow Dust
description: A prospector goes undercover to clear his name of robbery before he can lay claim to a mother lode of gold.

title: The Arizonian
description: A marshal, trying to end lawlessness and protect his brother and sweetheart, fights it out with a gang of crooks.

title: Cimarron
description: Husband-and-wife homesteaders (Richard Dix, Irene Dunne) join the Oklahoma land rush of 1889 and stay on to build an empire.

title: Ghost Valley
description: A crooked judge (Mitchell Harris) unwittingly hires the heir to a gold mine to scare his cousin (Merna Kennedy) into selling the property.

title: Annie Oakley
description: Awkward Annie (Barbara Stanwyck) loves her sharpshooting rival (Preston Foster) in Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show.

title: Scarlet River
description: An actor (Tom Keene) on the set of a cowboy movie rescues a rancher (Dorothy Wilson) from her foreman (Creighton Chaney).

title: Carl Laemmle
description: The extraordinary life story of Carl Laemmle, the German-Jewish immigrant who founded Universal Pictures and saved over 300 Jewish families from Nazi Germany.

title: Frankenstein
description: Baron Frankenstein creates a monster from cadavers and a killer's brain.

title: The Invisible Man
description: The serum that makes a scientist (Claude Rains) invisible has madness as a side effect.

title: The Black Cat
description: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
description: Corrupted by a lord (George Sanders), Oscar Wilde's London aristocrat (Hurd Hatfield) stays young, but his portrait begins to age.

title: The Beast With Five Fingers
description: A crawling hand chases a late concert pianist's personal secretary (Peter Lorre) around an Italian villa.

title: Cat People
description: A New York architect (Kent Smith) marries a Serbian artist (Simone Simon) who turns into a black panther when aroused.

title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra.

title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster.

title: The Lost City
description:
S01 E02 — The Tunnel of Flame
An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes.

title: Dr. Gillespie's Criminal Case
description: The doctor (Lionel Barrymore) tests an intern (Van Johnson), treats an epidemic and tries to place a killer in an asylum.
